Spread over 548 Sq.Ft this one bedroom apartment is the perfect apartment for any renter looking for a luxury home located in the heart of Ealing. The optimised floorplan, matched with the near floor to ceiling windows enables light to flood the apartment and make the 548 Sq.Ft feel even more expansive than it already is. Being a Berkeley development the attention to detail is nothing short of phenomenal, the zoned underfloor heating is a fantastic touch, as is the sleek and modern kitchen, integrated combination microwave oven and domino hob, marble effect laminate worktop & partially tiled splashback. The bedroom area of the apartment is nicely separated from the main living room, unlike a conventional studio and benefits from bespoke fitted wardrobes. As a resident of Filmworks, you have full access to the 24/7 concierge and secure bike storage found in the development, as well as a number of shops and restaurants that are open within the development. Providing over 200 contemporary homes, Filmworks will also include an eight screen cinema and central piazza surrounded by a high-quality mix of shops, restaurants and bars. Filmworks infuses a new dimension to Ealing’s enticing personality. Retaining the old cinema’s historic façade it will welcome a high quality mix of new homes, alongside a leisure district that showcases an exciting new destination for the capital. Filmworks’ public and private spaces will create an authentic sense of place that is sensitive to Ealing’s blend of historic and modern architecture, steeped in history and culture, interesting and hugely multicultural. Intending purchasers must rely on their own inspection of the property. None of the above appliances/services have been tested by Romans & Partners.
